cookieAuth.description: Session cookie. Unsafe methods also need the X-SD-CSRF header (from the sign-in response or GET /api/v1/auth/session) and an Origin equal to https://<Host>.

pendingAuth.description: The pending-2FA cookie set by auth.login (valid 5 minutes, 5 tries). It is not a session.
pendingAuth.name: __Host-sd_pending
